label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter-1, cold)
summary: All 60 requirements implemented across 16 Java files (2 controllers). 8 issues flagged: 3 invented defaults, 4 design choices, 1 ambiguous requirement.

issues.title: CD-GA-Beh6: GasDetected found-branch reroutes to Reading instead of a Final state
issues.raw: The requirement says the gas-analysis subsystem 'concludes its search, processing no further readings' after emitting stop. A RoboChart Final state on a theory-generated controller makes the Isabelle deadlock-freedom goal unprovable (CLAUDE.md 'Interpreting Isabelle Results'), so the stop branch emits the stop event and reroutes to Reading. The movement subsystem is in Found and ignores further turn/resume events, so the deviation is not observable at the system boundary.
issues.fix_directive: If a literal terminal state is required, re-introduce a Final mode on the gas-analysis controller and accept the Isabelle limitation, or confirm the reroute.

issues.title: CD-MV-Beh9: Found state given an event-triggered stop self-loop
issues.raw: 'Once in Found the movement subsystem stays halted' — implemented as an explicit self-loop on the stop event so the Found state has a bare-precondition operation (deadlock-freedom cover) without a tau-self-loop (divergence) or unconditional else (determinism).
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the stop self-loop is an acceptable encoding of 'remains stopped'.

issues.title: CD-OP4: changeDirection implemented on Vehicle rather than an operation class
issues.raw: CD-ARCH2 lists only move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk as Vehicle operations. changeDirection(l) takes a parameter and commands motion, which the operation-class compute() pattern (no-arg, field-assignments-only) cannot express, so it lives on Vehicle next to move.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm placement, or specify the intended operation-class shape for parameterised operations.

issues.title: CD-DM7/CD-Evt4..6: reading type and shared-event encoding
issues.raw: GasSensorReading is represented directly as List<GasSensor> (extracts to Seq(GasSensor)) instead of a wrapper record. The inter-controller events turn/stop/resume appear as records of the same simple name in both InputEvent (trigger side, movement) and OutputEvent (action side, gas-analysis) so the ETL can pair them into the Shared interface.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the unwrapped Seq representation and the dual-record shared-event encoding.

issues.title: Constant values invented (CD-Const1..6)
issues.raw: Requirements define names/types but no values: thr=1.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=2, stuckPeriod=5, stuckDist=1.0, outPeriod=3. Small integers keep the CSP state space tractable.
issues.fix_directive: Replace with the real deployment values if known.

issues.title: Chem species, target identity, and direction mapping invented
issues.raw: Chem is an enum {chemA, chemB} with chemA as the detection target (CD-DM4 calls it opaque). The 1-based sensing-direction mapping of CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 is realised as index 0->Front, 1->Left, 2->Right, 3->Back, >=4->Back.
issues.fix_directive: Supply the real species inventory, target selection mechanism, and sensor-direction layout if they matter.

issues.title: Empty-reading and detection defaults
issues.raw: Safe defaults for the initially-empty reading (CD-GA-Var1): analysis -> noGas, intensity -> 0.0, location -> Front. 'Reading indicates the target chemical' (CD-Fn1) is realised as c == target && i > 0.0.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the > 0.0 detection floor and the empty-reading defaults.

issues.title: Transition priority within movement modes unspecified
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR/Beh requirements list outgoing transitions without relative priority. Implemented order in every mode block: stop > turn > obstacle > resume > autonomous guards. CD-DC1 (unique source-state/trigger pairs) holds either way.
issues.fix_directive: Specify the intended priority if a different order is required.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> t2m -> m2m -> m2t -> dafny_gen -> isabelle_gen) and iterate on the visible feedback.
